title: Nearly a Third of Dutch Grid Waiting List Is Taken Up by Data Centers
source_used: Yahoo Finance analysis relaying Nieuwsuur and NL Times (full text)
key_facts: Data-centre companies have applied for approximately 15 gigawatts on the Dutch electricity-connection queue, more than the combined connection capacity of all Dutch households; the figure was reported by Nieuwsuur and attributed to Netbeheer Nederland, and is requested capacity, not actual consumption (Yahoo Finance).
Netbeheer Nederland, the association of Dutch grid operators, went public in October 2026 asking the government to decide how many data centres the Netherlands should host and where.

Connection waits can approach a decade, so developers apply early and generously; Stijn Grove, director of the Dutch Data Center Association, indicated according to Nieuwsuur that applicants request capacity well ahead.

NL Times estimates grid expansion across the Netherlands will cost more than 200 billion euros, and says 15,498 businesses were waiting for large connections in the first half of 2026, with requests of nearly 10,000 megawatts across all sectors.
State Secretary Jo-Annes de Bat has announced measures to release congested capacity faster; a nationwide spatial plan for data centres has not been confirmed.
Nearly 200 large facilities already operate, with roughly 200 more reportedly expected according to Nieuwsuur.
Joris de Groot of the grid company Alliander, speaking for Netbeheer Nederland, reportedly compared the situation to the Dutch nitrogen debate.
quote_evidence: Data-center companies have applied for approximately 15 gigawatts of capacity on the Dutch electricity-connection queue, more than the combined connection capacity of all Dutch households.
That figure, reported by Nieuwsuur and attributed to Netbeheer Nederland, represents requested capacity, not actual consumption.
State Secretary Jo-Annes de Bat has announced measures to release congested capacity faster.
why_it_matters_hint: Housing developers and factories waiting for a grid connection share a queue in which data-centre requests may be inflated, and grid operators want the government to set limits.
event_date: October 2026 (date of the Nieuwsuur report not stated)
notes: The Yahoo Finance text is an analysis piece that mixes reporting with the author's opinion (for example the Spotify pre-save comparison and its recommendations); only the attributed reporting is used. The 'nearly a third' in its headline is not backed by a figure in the text. Date of the original Nieuwsuur report is not stated.
